title: Git deploys
description: A push re-reads the branch head from your Git host and deploys it. Only project admins can change this.
empty: No repository is linked to this app.
baseUrlHint: Public https origin. It cannot be changed later: delete the link and create a new one.
tokenHint: Use a fine-grained token that can read the repository. Commit statuses also need status write. It is sealed and never shown again.
autoPromote: Make each production branch build live
unlinkDescription: The stored token and webhook secret are destroyed, and pushes stop deploying.
secretTitle: Add this webhook to your repository
secretHint: The secret is shown only now.
pausedHint: Paused after a manual rollback, so that the next push does not undo it. Builds still run, but nothing goes live on its own.
rulesHint: A push to a matching branch deploys to the named app branch. Use * within a path segment and ** across them.
autoSwitchHint: Sends the branch's build to production with production's secrets, with no review. Never applies to forks.
